canonical_name: Continuous image of a connected subset is connected
literal_source_claim_en: The continuous image of a connected set is connected.
canonical_statement: Candidate intake scope: for topological spaces X and Y, a subset E of X, and a continuous map f from X to Y, if E is nonempty and connected then its set-theoretic image f(E) is nonempty and connected.
canonical_claim: A continuous map sends every nonempty connected subset to a nonempty connected image.
statement_blocker: Before the exact statement gate, an independent reviewer must approve the nonempty connected-set convention, local-versus-global continuity transport, set-image encoding, ordered binders, universes, and boundary cases; then the canonical Lean expression must be elaborated, fingerprinted, transported, and mutation-tested. The uncited nineteenth-century attribution and source identity also remain open.

canonical_formal_target.candidate_expression: forall {alpha : Type u} {beta : Type v} [TopologicalSpace alpha] [TopologicalSpace beta] {s : Set alpha}, IsConnected s -> forall f : alpha -> beta, ContinuousOn f s -> IsConnected (f '' s)
canonical_formal_target.candidate_expression_status: pinned declaration elaborated by intake probe; canonical selection, normalized expression serialization, source transport, mutations, provenance, and proof credit remain downstream

domain_and_universes: Candidate scope: arbitrary universe-polymorphic types alpha and beta with arbitrary topological-space structures; a subset s of alpha; and a total function f : alpha -> beta considered only on s. Exact universe and implicit-instance serialization remains downstream.
quantifiers: for every pair of topological spaces alpha and beta
for every subset s of alpha
for every function f from alpha to beta
hypotheses: s is nonempty and preconnected, represented by IsConnected s
f is globally continuous, represented by Continuous f
conclusion: The direct set image f '' s is connected, represented by IsConnected (f '' s).
